Receipts.description: 1.0.0 (B6): an account's PENDING token-portal receipts, from the mirror. PENDING ONLY: the portal deletes a receipt entity when it is claimed or cancelled, so the mirror cannot hold a settled one — an empty list means nothing is waiting, NOT that nothing was ever withdrawn. History is the Kamiden-backed `portal` query.

ownerAddress.description: the zero address when the mirror holds none

operatorAddress.description: the CURRENT operator — the payout of an operator-lane claim made now; the zero address when the mirror holds none

receiptsTotal.description: every pending receipt the account holds; all are served (uncapped)

id.description: the receipt entity id — what claim and cancel take

itemAmount.description: net item units: toGameUnits(tokenAmount, scale) = floor(tokenAmount / 10^(18 − scale)), the contract's own conversion

tokenAmount.description: what the claim transfers, in token base units (18 dp): a uint256 as a decimal string

tax.description: export tax taken at withdraw time, item units (not refunded on cancel)

token.description: the token and scale the claim uses (the item registry's ERC20 registration, mirrored by the portal). For an item since unregistered: the receipt's own recorded address with scale 0 — and state PAUSED, since a claim would revert.

claimableNow.description: endTime <= the projection clock AND not paused. The portal-wide on/off switch is contract storage and is NOT mirrored.

lane.description: OPERATOR when the receipt carries the PORTAL_TO_OPERATOR flag (withdrawToOperator)

payout.description: where a claim made NOW would pay: the owner, or for an operator-lane receipt the account's CURRENT operator. The contract resolves the operator at claim time.

state.description: PAUSED: the receipt is admin-disabled (or its item unregistered); CLAIMABLE: endTime reached; WAITING: not yet
